mechanism: The bank retains up to 100 raw and cross-file neighbors per sparse/dense arm, guarded blocks and qualified containment. Fixed fusion adds equal 1/(60+rank) terms. The conditional route admits TF-IDF ≥ .35, prefix ≥ .65, tail ≥ .80, guarded blocks or containment; prefix and tail get one maximum-rank vote. Containment requires eight shared tokens, three call/attribute/key tokens, overlap mass ≥ .75 and cosine ≥ .1. Corrected v2 sorts token accumulation deterministically. Residual fitting uses standardized logistic regression C=.1, repository-lineage holdout and source-component purging; unlabeled candidates never become negatives.
